captureErr.capture-failed: The server failed while reading this screenshot. Fills from part of it may already be in Pending — check there before uploading it again.
captureErr.http-413: The upload was refused as too large before it reached the tracker. Images up to 8 MB are accepted, so a proxy in front of the server may have a lower limit.
captureErr.http-502: The server did not answer. The capture may still have completed — check Pending before uploading again.
captureErr.http-504: The server did not answer in time. The capture may still have completed — check Pending before uploading again.
captureErr.image-too-large: This image is larger than 8 MB.
captureErr.invalid-body: The upload was not understood. Pick the file again.
captureErr.unsupported-image: Only JPEG, PNG, WebP and GIF images can be read.
captureErr.vision-not-configured: Vision is not set up: set the vision base URL and model in Settings, then restart the server.
closedFillWarning: This fill belongs to a closed position. Saving re-derives all later history and may book a cash adjustment.
confirmClose: Close this run? No further buys.
correctionStale: This fill changed since the screenshot — dismiss this correction.
costDefaultFailed: Couldn't load the default cost. Enter one.

simErr.not-enough-bars: This date range has fewer than two trading days to simulate. Widen it.
simErr.server: The server hit an error ({code}). Try again.

upload.badExtractHttp: The vision service did not accept the request.
upload.badExtractIncompatible: The vision service answered, but not as an OpenAI-compatible API.

upload.bookedEarlier: Fills from this image were already confirmed earlier — the rows below may be duplicates. Check before confirming.

upload.dateSubstituted: No trade date was read, so {date} was used — check it in Pending.
upload.duplicate: Already uploaded, nothing new — every fill is booked or pending, or a correction is waiting in Pending.
upload.networkLost: The connection dropped before the server answered. The capture may still have completed — check Pending before uploading again.
upload.noRun: {ticker}: no active run — open the run and upload from its page.
upload.pinNomatch: No {ticker} fills in this image — run #{id} unchanged.
upload.pinSkipped: Ignored {tickers} — not the ticker of run #{id}.
upload.title: Upload screenshot

visionReviewDeleteWarning: Delete this screenshot and its detected-vs-corrected record? This cannot be undone.
